result.topic_en: Hilbert notes that the convergence of the power series of e^{-1/(1-x)} everywhere on the unit circle, shown by Saalschütz through computation, follows from Fourier expansion, and he begins stating a general theorem on convergence on the boundary of the circle of convergence when there are finitely many singular points.
